secrets.name: The Right Way Up
secrets.text: You climb the chandelier into a bookcase and come out standing on a floor, under a ceiling, with a lamp that shines down. After the hall it is almost too much.

meta.label: The Upside-Down Reading Room
meta.blurb: The reading room is on the ceiling, and nothing has fallen off it. You are the only thing in here the wrong way up.
